listing.name: The Beatles: Rock Band — The Beatles: Rock Band for PC (Xbox 360 recomp) — WIP 0.6.1 (mercurialw0rld)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports keyboard guitar and drum play near 60 FPS. Stutter, calibration issues and incomplete DLC and instrument testing remain. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own The Beatles: Rock Band Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Default.xex, charnames.zbm and complete gen/header/ten ARKs; data-only DLC optional; no TU/code-DLC.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use portable release and select own default.xex with charnames.zbm and complete gen/ARK files; data-only DLC needs no recompilation.

warnings: The project reports keyboard guitar and drum play near 60 FPS. Stutter, calibration issues and incomplete DLC and instrument testing remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
